snippet.title: Brushland | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/5163450/Brushland

A fairytale kingdom-builder where every tile you paint makes a difference. Shape the land, welcome the villagers, and tend to their needs until a handful of tiles becomes a country they love.

Created by Michał Marcinkowski - the maker of Soldat and King Arthur's Gold.

Coming to Steam Q1-Q2 2027
